sentences.en: The public at large are dissatisfied with the present government.
sentences.zh: 公众普遍对当前政府感到不满意。

sentences.en: My boss told me that he was dissatisfied with me.
sentences.zh: 我的老板告诉我他对我不满意。

sentences.en: They said that they were dissatisfied with their low wages.
sentences.zh: 他们表示对自己的低工资感到不满。

senses.zh: 使不满（dissatisfy的过去式和过去分词）
不满意的；不高兴的；流露不满的
